topic: A person's car is towed from their own driveway
text: I just got home from picking up some groceries, and my car is gone. Not just moved to the side or anything, it’s completely vanished from the driveway. I remember parking it right here this morning. I checked the neighbors' driveways, even peeked around the corner in case someone had borrowed it as a joke, but it's nowhere to be seen. The driveway is empty, just a few tire marks left as if it was here at all. I’m going to call around, see if anyone knows what happened, but this is really throwing me off. Must be some kind of misunderstanding, right?
